hypotheses: H1 (primary, equivalence): under the description-only harness, tool-call recall for the needed skill does not differ between C1 and C0 beyond the margin.
H2 (equivalence): with memory files compressed (C2), the activated-skill distribution matches C0 within the equivalence bounds on total-variation distance.
H3 (positive control, superiority): destructive body compression (C4) reduces tool-call recall relative to C0; if it does not, H1 and H2 are reported as inconclusive, not as equivalence.
primary_contrast: C1 vs C0, paired within PR, description-only harness (H1)

recall_definition.gold: load_skill(neededSkillId) plus read_file(path) for every file the PR added or modified; files with change_status removed are excluded
recall_definition.score: hits / required; 0 when nothing was called, never NaN
recall_definition.independence: derived from pr_files, never from the transcript

exclusions: no skill body in the repository
judge produced no usable needed-skill label after one retry
PR body fails the reproducibility screen
not_exclusions: turn or token budget exhaustion (kept in the outcome set with its termination reason)

analysis.h1: TOST on the paired within-PR recall difference, 90% CI against the margin

hash_rule: sha256 is the SHA-256 of this file's bytes with the sha256 value replaced by 64 zeros; the sidecar .sha256 is the SHA-256 of the file as committed

frame.eligibility: code-changing PRs that do not add or edit a SKILL.md; both rules apply before the draw, never as exclusions after it

labels.primary: LLM judge from a different model family than the study model, reading PR title and body only — never the diff, never the condition
labels.calibration: 20-30 PR human-labelled set; agreement reported with the disagreements listed
labels.exact_path_rule: retired as a gate: on the drawn frame it fires for 0/200 analysis PRs (its pool hits were the SKILL.md-editing PRs), so it is reported as availability, not concordance
labels.body_path_rule: sensitivity subset: at least one skill body names a file the PR changed; fires for 32/200 analysis PRs (16.0%)
labels.gate: no mechanical signal excludes a PR; disagreement is reported, never filtered
